N11#2.zh: 我是『%M』%N！你们哪一个人是晁盖？
N11#2.t: I am '%M' %N! Which of you is Chao Gai?

N11#3.zh: 行不更名、坐不改姓；『托塔天王』晁盖就是本人。这位壮士有何贵干？
N11#3.t: I never change my name: 'Pagoda King' Chao Gai, that's me. What brings you here, hero?

N11#4.zh: 少罗嗦！快把『生辰纲』还来！
N11#4.t: Cut the chatter! Hand back the 'birthday gifts'!

N11#5.zh: 哦？原来是梁中书的走狗。想必你一定从他那里得到不少好处吧！是卖私盐？还是开赌场？
N11#5.t: Oh? So you're Secretary Liang's lapdog. You must have got plenty out of him! Selling illegal salt? Running a gambling den?

N11#7.zh: 狗果然是狗。只知道死忠，却不知自己的主人做了什么事。连白痴都知道，清官哪有可能搜集这么多珠宝珍玩献给自己的岳父祝寿呢？当然不是贪污就是压榨民脂民膏！而你们这些走狗就是真正的帮凶！
N11#7.t: A dog is a dog after all: blindly loyal, with no idea what its master has done. Even an idiot knows an honest official couldn't gather so many jewels and treasures for his father-in-law's birthday! It's either embezzled or squeezed from the people's sweat and blood! And you lapdogs are the real accomplices!

N11#9.zh: 我们将会代表平民百姓的怒吼，给腐败的高官们迎头痛击！
N11#9.t: We speak for the anger of the common people, and we'll strike the corrupt officials hard!

N11#10.zh: 这种大话我也听多了。每一个强盗在发威时看起来都是英雄无敌、豪气万千；碰到生死关头时，却常常是跪下求饶，分明是狗熊一个。现在把『生辰纲』交出来，我还可以放你一条生路；否则，就只有强行用武力夺取！
N11#10.t: I've heard such big talk plenty of times. Every bandit looks like an invincible hero when he's in full swing; when it's life or death, he's usually on his knees begging, a coward through and through. Hand over the 'birthday gifts' now and I'll spare your life. Otherwise I'll take them by force!

N11#11.zh: 有趣！有本事你就打倒我抢回『生辰纲』吧！
N11#11.t: Interesting! If you've got what it takes, beat me and take back the 'birthday gifts'!

N11#12.zh: 晁盖一伙日后都是同道中人。打倒晁盖便能问出生辰纲的下落；吴用、公孙胜等人体力不到三成就会罢手，不必赶尽杀绝。
N11#12.t: Chao Gai's band will be comrades one day. Defeat Chao Gai to learn where the birthday gifts are; Wu Yong, Gongsun Sheng and the others will stop fighting below 30% HP, so there's no need to kill them.

N11#14.zh: 胜利条件   --- 打败晁盖

N11#16.zh: 失败条件二 --- 杨志死亡

N11#17.zh: 晁大哥！你没事吧！我带增援来了！
N11#17.t: Brother Chao! Are you all right? I've brought help!

N11#18.zh: 我们阮家三兄弟也来助阵！
N11#18.t: We three Ruan brothers are here to help too!

N11#20.zh: 嗯。对方只有几个人！再加把劲就可以把他们全部捉起来啦！
N11#20.t: Mm. There are only a few of them! A little more effort and we'll catch them all!

N11#21.zh: 敌人发动总攻击了！大家小心！
N11#21.t: The enemy is launching an all-out attack! Careful, everyone!

N11#22.zh: 限制回合数已到，未完成任务，游戏失败！

N11#23.zh: %N死亡后，众人眼见生辰纲无法夺回，于是一哄而散，浪迹天涯，不知所终........
N11#23.t: With %N dead, the others saw the birthday gifts could not be recovered, scattered, and wandered the world, never heard of again........

N11#24.zh: 生辰纲无法取回，%N与众人也不敌庄客围攻，晁盖将众人杀害之后，毁尸灭迹，世上再也无人得知生辰纲下落........
N11#24.t: The birthday gifts could not be recovered, and %N and the others could not withstand the farmhands. Chao Gai had them all killed and the bodies destroyed, and no one in the world ever learned where the birthday gifts went........

N11#25.zh: 晁盖一倒，庄客们都住了手。
N11#25.t: With Chao Gai down, the farmhands all stopped fighting.

N11#26.t: Tr... truly, heroes come from the young...

N11#28.t: No! Not even if you beat me to death!

N11#29.zh: 你明明已经输定了，为何还要抵抗？！
N11#29.t: You've clearly lost. Why keep resisting?!

N11#30.zh: 拳脚功夫不如人，我死有余辜...抱歉，吴用、还有大家...我没有办法达到你们的希望...
N11#30.t: My fists weren't good enough; death is no more than I deserve... Sorry, Wu Yong, everyone... I couldn't fulfil your hopes...

N11#32.zh: 除尽贪官污吏、替天行道啊...果然还是遥不可及的梦想... 你叫什么名字？
N11#32.t: Rid the land of corrupt officials, act on Heaven's behalf... still a distant dream after all... What's your name?

N11#34.zh: %N啊...好名字。来吧！过来取我的首级！这个功劳可以让你享尽荣华富贵！首谋者是我！就放其他人走吧！
N11#34.t: %N... a good name. Come! Come and take my head! The credit will bring you wealth and glory! I'm the ringleader! Let the others go!

N11#35.zh: (不...不一样！这个人不是普通人！我该不该把这种人杀了...？)
N11#35.t: (No... he's different! This is no ordinary man! Should I kill someone like this...?)

N11#37.zh: 这不是宋押司吗？怎么你也赶到这里来了？
N11#37.t: Isn't this Clerk Song? What brings you here too?

N11#38.zh: 果然是林教头，我还以为我认错了呢！在下宋江，幸会幸会。
N11#38.t: It is Instructor Lin after all. I thought I was mistaken! I'm Song Jiang. A pleasure, a pleasure.

N11#39.zh: 这位是宋江，字公明。因为他面黑身矮，又孝名远播，大家叫他孝义黑三郎。为人仗义疏财，平生只好结识英雄好汉；凡是有难投靠他的人，他绝不推托；凡是听到谁有困难，他必定亲自相助。大家都叫他『及时雨』宋江，把他比成干旱时天上下的及时雨，能救万物苍生。
N11#39.t: This is Song Jiang, styled Gongming. Being dark and short, and famous for his devotion to his father, people call him the 'Dutiful Dark Third Son'. He's generous and righteous and loves nothing more than befriending heroes; he never turns away anyone in trouble who comes to him, and whenever he hears someone is in need he helps in person. Everyone calls him 'Timely Rain' Song Jiang, likening him to rain that falls in a drought and saves all living things.

N11#41.zh: 林教头太过奖了。不过，这位『托塔天王』晁盖也是个铁铮铮的汉子；亦是我的旧识。能否看在小弟的薄面上，放他一条生路？
N11#41.t: You flatter me, Instructor Lin. But 'Pagoda King' Chao Gai here is a man of iron, and an old friend of mine. For my humble sake, could you spare his life?

N11#43.t: Then what about the birthday gifts...?

N11#44.zh: 对了，刚才你们离开后，何涛也刻意要我先回官府；我心有怀疑，就偷偷折回看看何涛想做什么。结果，何涛正率领着大军往这里前进！不仅是晁盖六人有危险，说不定何涛连你们也想要一起解决！
N11#44.t: Right. After you left, He Tao made a point of sending me back to the yamen first. I had my doubts, so I quietly doubled back to see what he was up to. And He Tao is leading a large force this way! Not only are Chao Gai and his five in danger; He Tao may mean to finish you off as well!

N11#46.zh: ...这不是没有可能；少了我们，就没有人会跟他抢功...
N11#46.t: ...It's not impossible. Without us, no one would compete with him for the credit...

N11#47.zh: 何涛的部队随时都会到；各位，请小心。
N11#47.t: He Tao's troops could arrive any moment. Everyone, be careful.

N11#48.t: He Tao wants all the credit for himself...?

N11#49.zh: 大事不好！官军已经把东溪村团团围住！
N11#49.t: Disaster! Government troops have surrounded East Creek Village!

N11#50.zh: 我不相信！我去跟何涛理论！
N11#50.t: I don't believe it! I'll go and have it out with He Tao!

N11#52.zh: 看这个情况，随时可能会发动攻击...
N11#52.t: By the look of it, they could attack any moment...

N11#53.zh: 不用顾虑我...重伤的人是跑不远的；你们各自逃生吧！%N，你们也走吧。
N11#53.t: Don't worry about me... a badly wounded man can't run far. Save yourselves! %N, you go too.

N11#54.zh: 看样子我们是在同一条船上... 走吧！我们一起逃出去！
N11#54.t: Looks like we're in the same boat... Come on! We'll break out together!

N11#55.t: (Chao Gai, Wu Yong and Bai Sheng join!)

N11#56.zh: 你要如何面对这种局势呢？
N11#56.t: How will you face this situation?

N11#57.t: Fine skill! This poor Taoist will stop here.

N11#58.zh: 罢了，罢了！小生认输，不再动手。
N11#58.t: Enough, enough! I concede and will fight no more.

N11#59.zh: 哥哥们都住了手，俺也不打了！
N11#59.t: My brothers have stopped, so I'm done too!

N11#60.t: Impressive... I, Liu Tang, am done fighting!

N11#61.t: What a man! I, Ruan Xiao'er, submit!
